title: Land Better Jobs with This AI-Powered System ..
description:
Most people apply for jobs manually.

The smartest candidates are building systems.

Here's a simple AI-powered job search workflow:

• ChatGPT 5.5 → Build and tailor resumes
• LoopCV → Automate applications
• Claude Opus 4.8 → Personalize recruiter outreach
• Huntr → Track opportunities and interviews
• Interviewing.io → Practice before the real interview

The goal isn't to send more applications.

It's to send better applications at scale.

Save this for your next career move.
